advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.desc: Discover the fish that inhabit this world
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.hump: A chilly fish with a hump on its back and absolutely no plans to move somewhere warmer.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.alas: A tiny Alaskan survivor that treats freezing temperatures like a minor inconvenience.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.spoo: A tiny bottom dweller with a head shaped like someone dropped a spoon on its face.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.nort: A patient ambush predator that can turn "just a peaceful pond" into a horror movie.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.sibe: An ancient Siberian giant that has been around so long it probably remembers when the water was new.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.stri: A striped swimmer dressed for an underwater gala that nobody else was invited to.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.crap: A fish with an unfortunate name and the confidence to be delicious anyway.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.wall: Those weird reflective eyes aren't a fashion statement. They're basically built-in night vision.
An armored prehistoric fish that looks like it missed the memo about which millennium it lives in.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.musk: A freshwater predator so impressive that everyone just calls it a muskie because apparently its full name is too powerful.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.blue: A colorful little sunfish that looks innocent right up until it steals your bait and leaves.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.carp: A hardy freshwater fish that survives almost anything including fishing attempts that should have worked.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.catf: A whiskered fish with no cat no interest in climbing trees and an excellent relationship with the bottom.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.bass: A powerful freshwater predator and the reason many anglers can turn "just one cast" into an entire afternoon.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.medi: A tiny fish with a name that sounds like it has a very specific appointment with destiny.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.fres: A tiny fish that responds to danger by becoming a spiky balloon. Honestly fair.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.lamp: An ancient jawless fish with a mouth that looks like nature invented a suction cup and gave it teeth vibes.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.tuni: A hardy little fish from North Africa that has mastered the ancient art of simply not dying.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.euro: A mysterious fish that spends its life traveling between rivers and oceans because apparently one neighborhood wasn't enough.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.gupp: A tiny colorful fish that can turn a peaceful aquarium into a rapidly expanding apartment complex.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.buju: A South American cichlid proving once again that small fish can have absolutely enormous personalities.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.pira: A famous freshwater predator with terrifying teeth and a reputation that may be doing most of the work.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.armo: A whiskered bottom dweller wearing natural armor like it expects a boss fight at any moment.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.arap: One of the world's biggest freshwater fish because apparently regular-sized fish weren't impressive enough.
A cold-water classic that has been feeding people for centuries and still hasn't asked for a raise.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.salm: A determined fish that swims upstream fights rapids and refuses to accept that "going back" is a bad idea.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.herr: A small silver fish that travels in enormous groups because apparently personal space is overrated.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.wolf: A cold-water predator with jaws and teeth that make it look like it has unresolved business with the ocean.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.skat: A flat relative of rays that glides along the seafloor like an aquatic carpet with somewhere to be.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.blac: A sturdy coastal predator that spends its days hunting around reefs and rocky hideouts.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.monk: An ugly ambush predator that waves a little lure around and lets dinner come to it. Peak laziness honestly.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.opah: A brilliantly colored fish that can keep much of its body warmer than the surrounding water. Basically wearing its own heated blanket.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.anch: A tiny silver fish that travels in enormous schools and somehow manages to be both small and extremely important.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.shad: A schooling fish famous for seasonal migrations and the stubborn determination to make the trip every year.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.flyi: It doesn't technically fly but it launches out of the water and glides far enough to make the distinction feel petty.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.stur: An ancient armored fish that grows enormous and looks like it was downloaded from the prehistoric DLC.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.swor: A powerful ocean predator carrying a giant sword on its face because apparently subtlety was never an option.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.rain: A reef fish so colorful it looks like someone spilled an entire box of crayons into the ocean.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.gurn: A strange bottom dweller with leg-like fins that make it look dangerously close to discovering walking.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.flou: A fish that grows up to swim sideways and somehow ends up with both eyes on the same side. Problem solved apparently.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.mahi: A fast colorful ocean predator that looks like it got dressed by a very enthusiastic artist.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.pain: A boldly patterned reef eel with a permanent expression of "Go ahead. Make my day."
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.oarf: A giant ribbon-shaped deep-sea fish that looks less like dinner and more like something sailors invented after seeing a nightmare.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.pale: A pale fish from the Pale Garden that looks like it hasn't seen sunlight since the beginning of time.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.echo: A mysterious eel from the Deep Dark that seems perfectly happy living somewhere every noise sounds ten times scarier.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.axol: You were fishing for fish. The axolotl has decided that technicalities are beneath it.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.bamb: Not a fish. Not even remotely a fish. Your fishing rod is apparently branching into gardening.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.bowl: An empty bowl suggesting the fish either escaped or was never invited to dinner.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.fish: The fish escaped. Its skeleton apparently wasn't fast enough.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.frog: You were aiming for a fish and somehow caught a frog. Fishing has become less specific.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.ink_: A suspiciously inky package from something that clearly wanted to leave no witnesses.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.leat: Not a fish not treasure but apparently the ocean's idea of a participation prize.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.lily: A perfectly good lily pad. Not edible not a fish but excellent if you suddenly need pond furniture.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.stri: Either a very unlucky spider or a fisherman having an unusually successful day.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.tadp: Tiny wiggly and very much not ready to become dinner. Give it a few upgrades first.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.trip: Someone lost a trap and your fishing rod apparently decided to become a detective.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.wate: You went fishing and caught water. Technically a flawless catch. Nobody said it had to be interesting.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.ench: A mysterious enchanted book pulled from the water. Hopefully the magic works better when dry.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.ches: Someone buried a fortune down here and thought putting TNT next to the diamonds was perfectly reasonable.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.crys: A mysterious crystal treasure that looks far too important to have been sitting at the bottom of a lake.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.emer: An ancient coin dredged from the depths. Either treasure or someone's very expensive mistake.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.ench: An enchanted fishing rod recovered from the depths. Even legendary fishermen apparently lose their gear.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.naut: A beautiful shell from the depths because the ocean apparently leaves souvenirs.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.trop: A brilliantly colorful reef fish available in more patterns than anyone reasonably needs.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.puff: A normally small fish that turns into a spiky balloon the moment things get awkward.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.pale: Pale Garden moss hanging overhead like the forest has grown an impressive collection of spooky curtains.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.resi: A sticky orange clump of resin from the Pale Garden. Congratulations you caught tree goo.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.scul: A strange Deep Dark growth that spreads across surfaces like living darkness with absolutely no respect for personal space.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.echo: A mysterious shard from an Ancient City carrying the memories of what it used to be...and probably several bad decisions.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.sulf: A chunk that either means you're exploding into bits or getting sent up from a geyser. Or one step closer to crafting green dye. Not sure.
advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.goat: Because when you go fishing, the first thing you need is a loud way to let everyone know that you've caught the wrong fish again.

advancements.matcha.anglers_almanac.glow: A little glowing dust pulled from the water. Not treasure, but it is shiny.
